title: Intro and Course Features of JustinGuitar Beginner Course
summary: This opening video presents Justin Sandercoe welcoming learners to the JustinGuitar Beginner Course, emphasizing that the course is free, structured into individual lessons, and suitable for acoustic or electric guitarists. It introduces unique tooling and resources designed to support practice and progression, including the My Practice Assistant for building customized routines and tracking progress, a left-handed practice journey showcased via the Nitsuj series, an editable practice-time system, and a companion Beginner Song Course app with hundreds of backing tracks. The video also highlights play-along videos as an accessible alternative to the app, and closes with requests for donations to sustain free access and ongoing improvements.
topics: My Practice Assistant (practice items, timing, statistics)
